verdict.rationale: Klaviyo supports recurring automated workflows via its Flows feature (event-based automations) built through drag-and-drop, and the MCP server lets an AI agent assist with campaign creation and view flow performance reports, but there's no evidence the MCP/API surface lets an AI-native user actually create or schedule new recurring flows/jobs programmatically—automation building remains UI-centric. missing for 10: API/MCP endpoint to create or schedule flows, evidence of programmatic recurring job scheduling, and independent confirmation of AI-driven automation creation.
